_note: Napoleon's side of the release builder (release/core/build_release.py reads this, release/napoleon/components.json and licenses.json). Names, pins and release rules; code lives in release/core.

player_ini._note: The player's ini lists only the keys a player may change. It omits the dev, headless and proof keys and the exe-guard keys; the gate (tests/test_release_values.py) proves every omitted key's DLL default equals its release value, so omitting is safe. A component's ini_set keys are added (the UI scale stop-gap sets dev.file_rules until a DLL job gives it a player key).

release_values._note: Keys that must be 'off' at their release value (false, 0 or empty) and the ones with a required value. Parameters of an off feature (a delay, a folder) are inert and listed in inert_parameters.

known_limits: Multiplayer is untested: whether the added packs or the proxy change multiplayer matching has not been checked with two machines.

Steam is the only supported install, on NVIDIA graphics cards (D13), in English (D14), on the unmodified Steam build of Napoleon.exe. After a game update the remaster switches itself off until a build for that exe exists.
The UI scale stop-gap is one fixed factor, 2x, for 3840x2160. Other resolutions are not scaled yet, and engine-drawn text, the loading screen, cursors and the battle radar position stay at 1x (J67).
Changing the resolution inside the game from 2560x1440 to 3840x2160 can crash the game (engine fact napoleon.crash.res_switch_stack_overflow): set the resolution before you start.
The installer never changes Napoleon.exe. It only adds files; Uninstall.cmd moves them away and checks the game folder against the snapshot taken before the install.
